audited_nodes.meaning: South Atlantic active seismic illumination itself can occupy or approach the Cousteau frequency neighborhood; source-spectrum separation is mandatory.
Rich raw beam-time-series data are available for real South Atlantic geology, but their transmit bands are not evidence for a ~520 Hz target resonance.

tests.question: Does the expanded Atlantic domain contain enough traceable real acoustic/geophysical data to support a multi-zone control corpus?
evidence: M121 raw EM122 in the SE Atlantic
M148 raw EM122 across the South Atlantic
M132 raw EM122 in the eastern South Atlantic
MSM20/1 raw EM1002 and EM120 beam-time-series plus PARASOUND at Walvis Ridge
M49/1 multichannel seismic data on the Namibia/Walvis sector
NOAA/NCEI worldwide marine trackline archive with bathymetry, seismic, side-scan and subbottom classes

tests.question: Do currently traceable measurements/anomaly controls converge uniquely on the frozen LOVE-EDEM anchor?
evidence: No Tier-A exact local acoustic dataset has yet been admitted at the anchor.
Nearest verified M121 environmental control is ~114 km away; documented ~3S transect misses by ~96 km meridionally.
Nearest strong natural geoacoustic controls are Kouilou/Regab ~679-683 km east/east-southeast.
Rich real-acoustic surveys occur throughout Z3-Z4 South Atlantic without selecting the anchor.
tests.meaning: The present corpus does not show a unique spatial attractor at the frozen point.

tests.question: Can a ~520 Hz or nearby spectral feature by itself identify a target/resonator in the Atlantic-wide corpus?
evidence: Existing mandatory natural controls include iceberg harmonic tremor, whale calls, bio-duck and fish swimbladder resonance.

M49/1 used active seismic source bands of 30-200 Hz, 100-500 Hz and 200-1600 Hz, demonstrating that real South Atlantic survey illumination can itself overlap or approach the candidate frequency neighborhood.
tests.required_rule: Recover or marginalize X(f) before attributing any spectral feature to S_target; full modal/phase/decay fingerprint outranks absolute frequency.

tests.question: Do currently located public Atlantic datasets already permit calibrated recovery of a complex resonant target transfer function?
evidence: Raw multibeam and beam-time-series products support morphology, travel-time, bathymetric and propagation-control work.
M49/1 processed multichannel seismic supports low-frequency structure and illuminator controls.
A calibrated phase-referenced transmit waveform plus complex return suitable for H_target(f) recovery has not yet been established for the frozen Africa anchor or Titanic calibration.
tests.meaning: Geometry/control tests can run now; transformed-resonator identity gate cannot yet be closed.

tests.question: Are there strong natural Atlantic structures capable of generating unusual acoustic/backscatter signatures within the expanded influence zone?
evidence: Kouilou/Regab pockmark, gas/hydrate, carbonate and fluid-flow systems occur ~679-683 km from anchor.
Walvis Ridge and Namibia margin surveys show complex slope/ridge/abyssal morphology and seafloor depressions with dense hydroacoustic/seismic coverage.
tests.meaning: Any future candidate must quantitatively beat a large natural-geology control family; unusual morphology/backscatter alone is insufficient.

tests.question: Do historical sonar/UAP anomaly cases independently recur at or near the frozen anchor?
evidence: Gallaudet 1980s and Soviet quacker cases remain unlocatable from public raw coordinates.
Puerto Rico legacy numerical claims remain unverified in the current corpus.
No traceable historical anomaly case currently supplies repeat geodetic convergence on the anchor.
tests.meaning: Historical stories do not presently raise the anchor-specific prior.

tests.question: Has the Cousteau pipeline already passed the known-real-target Titanic exam needed before target identity interpretation?
evidence: Public raw SeaBeam multibeam and sound-speed profiles were recovered for Titanic survey calibration.
tests.meaning: Africa target identity interpretation remains blocked.

aggregate_verdict.plain_meaning: Expanding to the whole Atlantic gives Cousteau many real measurements and strong controls, but it does not currently reveal a unique anomaly centered on LOVE-EDEM. The strongest scientific gain is a harder false-positive firewall and several real datasets for geometry/propagation testing.
